Coram:
 Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
Order Order

. The petitioner has challenged the order dated 10.12.2024 passed in connection with Athamalik P.S. Case No.117 of 2019 corresponding to G.R. Case No.535(A) of 2019 for commission of the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(n)/417 of the IPC, pending in the Court of the learned S.D.J.M., Athamalik by which the N.B.W. has been issued against him.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner was admitted to bail on 03.07.2020, however, he could not appear before the learned Court below leading to issuance of the N.B.W. against him on 10.12.2024.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction, submits that, the petitioner would surrender/appear before the learned Court below on or before 28.03.2025 and seek remedy available to him under law.

4. On the basis of the aforementioned facts and submissions made at the Bar, the order dated 10.12.2024 passed in connection with Athamalik P.S. Case No.117 of 2019 corresponding to G.R.
Case No.535(A) of 2019, pending in the Court of the learned S.D.J.M., Athamalik is set aside, subject to the petitioner surrendering before the Court below on or before 28.03.2025 and depositing cost of Rs.500/- (Rupees five hundred) with District Bar Association, Athamalik.
Liberty is granted to the petitioner to avail remedy under law after surrendering as per the undertaking.
